The three that fit best:

MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN: ₹43,219 Ryzen 5 7530U, 16GB, 512GB SSD. The most memory for the money.
MSI Modern 14 C7M-063IN: ₹42,799 Ryzen 5 7530U, 8GB, 512GB SSD. The cheapest of the three, same chip as the first.
Dell DC15255: ₹47,990 Ryzen 5 7520U, 8GB, 512GB SSD. A newer AI (Sep 2025), but it costs more for less memory.

The two MSI AI first came out in Mar 2023, so they are older designs. The Acer Travel Lite TL14-42M with 16GB is ₹49,999 but it has only a Ryzen 3. Prices come from Smartprix, updated Wed 28 Oct 2026, and shop prices may differ.
